name: Albany
type: big city; county seat; city in the state of New York
text: Albany (  AWL-bə-nee) is the capital city of the U.S. state of New York. It is also the county seat of, and the most populous city in Albany County. Albany is located on the west bank of the Hudson River, approximately ten miles (16 km) south of its confluence with the Mohawk River.

depictions.text: Albany, New York Albany is the capital of the state of New York, United States. It was also one of the oldest settlements of the British Colonies and one of the largest cities of the Hudson River Valley during the 18th century.
